en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on the Buddha: 1.
The Question Concerning the Existence and Non-existence of the Buddha.
"Venerable Nāgasena, have you seen the Buddha?
“Then did those teachers see the Buddha?
“In that case, venerable Nāgasena, there is no Buddha.”
“But, Great King, did you see the river Ūhā in the Himalayas?
“Then did your father see the river Ūhā?”
“In that case, Great King, there is no river called the Ūhā.
“There is, Bhante. Although I have not seen the river Ūhā, nor has my father seen the river Ūhā, nevertheless, the river Ūhā exists.”
“In the same way, Great King, although I have not seen the Blessed One, nor has the Blessed One been seen by my teachers, nevertheless, the Blessed One exists.
This was the first question concerning the existence and non-existence of the Buddha.
